name: Image Converter
desc: Convert images between JPG, PNG and WebP in bulk
seoTitle: Image Converter: JPG, PNG & WebP Online
seoDescription: Convert images between JPG, PNG and WebP for free. Bulk convert many files at once, choose quality, and download as a ZIP. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Change the format of your pictures in seconds. Convert PNG to JPG, JPG to WebP, WebP to PNG and more, one file or a hundred at a time. Transparent areas turn into a colour of your choice when saving as JPG.
steps: Choose the format to convert to: JPG, PNG or WebP.
Adjust quality for JPG and WebP.
Click Convert and download the files or a ZIP.

faq.a: Use JPG for photos, PNG when you need transparency or sharp graphics, and WebP for the smallest files on websites.
JPG can't be transparent, so transparent areas are filled with the background colour you pick (white by default). PNG and WebP keep transparency.
Only the first frame is converted.
